rule: Host-owned concerns are adapter contracts; immutable OmniRoute source remains unchanged.

contracts.purpose: Map host user/org/tenant identity into platform request context.
Provide secret/key storage and retrieval without embedding host secrets in immutable source.
Bind platform persistence and migration lifecycle to the host database boundary.
Translate host plans, subscriptions and entitlements into platform quotas/feature access.
Bind application-specific retrieval/vector storage and document tenancy to platform context/memory.
Route platform telemetry/audit/events to host logging, tracing and retention systems.
Provide host email/webhook/notification delivery and retry policy.
Keep commercial branding, navigation, pricing and product presentation outside immutable core.
Bind processes, network policy, domains, storage and deployment-specific infrastructure.
